notes.note: Belial (label confirmed: 0731.bla MessWinSet(TextIdOffset+551) shows row n+1). Spoken before his lightning attack; he then leaves the scene.

0731.bla second-half leader chain (Pt_Chara_Check 5,4,3,2,1,15,14,13,12,11,10,9,8,7,6): blocks #0.555-569 (+554+k) and #0.571-585 (+570+k) run OOO, W, Den-O Sword, Black RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, 00, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Nu. Confirmed by #0.576-580 (the five Ultras) dropping the 'damn you' suffix. Pain cries follow earlier slices' romanizations.
Never shown by 0731.bla (no MessWinSet for n=569). Speaker and addressee unknown; kept neutral 'Are you all right'.

#0.590-604 is a 15-row leader block that 0731.bla never displays (Ankh's +588 is followed directly by Seravee's +605, which points one row past the table's last entry #0.605). No Pt order applies, so variants are voiced from wording: #0.595 casual, #0.597 Momotaros-rough, #0.600 rough, #0.594/602/603 emphatic. Generic 'you' kept for the impersonal Japanese. Identical Japanese kept identical.

Unlabelled in the slice; the script's last line is Seravee's Voice at +605 (off by one, see #0.590). Content is Seravee's cautious reply to the leader's 'we have to go anyway', so voiced as Seravee (Tieria).
'Graveyard' = the Monster Graveyard (the source just says 'the graveyard').

0733.bla first leader chain 15,14,5,4,10,9,13,12,11,3,2,1,8,7,6; block rows #0.9+2k / #0.10+2k: Zero, Mebius, OOO (#0.13-14), W (#0.15 Philip / #0.16 W), 00 (#0.17-18), Wing Zero (#0.19-20), Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Den-O (#0.27-28), Black RX (#0.29-30), Rider 1, God (#0.33-34 King of Hearts), Zeta, Nu. Content matches every special variant. Standard pair is identical Japanese for Zero/Mebius/Taro/Seven/Ultraman/RX(/Rider 1), so identical English.
Second half of the sentence begun in #0.9 (which trails off); written as its own clause so it reads after the ellipsis.
00 and Wing Zero say 'negative power' instead of 'evil power'; kept distinct. #0.19 differs only in a particle, so same English as #0.17.
OOO variant; script shows W/OOO special branches. 'Heroes help each other out, right?' keeps Eiji's soft tag question.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0731.bla and 0733.bla (slice labels correct where present). #0.570 and the #0.590-604 leader block are never displayed by 0731.bla; #0.590-604 voiced from wording and #0.605 assigned to Seravee's Voice by content (script points one past the table end). No new names or terms.
